ef24310d.title: Program Manager SWUS upgrades
ef24310d.description:
****Grow With us****
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead end\-to\-end Software Upgrade Subscription (SWUS) upgrade programs for strategic customers. The role will be accountable for converting upgrade commitments into safe, predictable, and commercially sound delivery outcomes across planning, technical readiness, execution, testing, customer acceptance, and handover.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work across customer, product, engineering, service delivery, operations, commercial, and partner teams. They will create clarity in complex, multi\-dependency environments and ensure that upgrade programs are delivered with strong governance, transparent communication, disciplined change control, and a relentless focus on customer value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program ownership and delivery**
* Own the integrated program plan from initiation through final acceptance and closure.
* Translate SWUS commitments, customer priorities, product roadmaps, and maintenance lifecycle needs into a clear upgrade roadmap and executable delivery plan.
* Establish delivery milestones, critical paths, dependencies, resource plans, governance forums, and decision points.
* Coordinate multiple upgrade workstreams across cloud infrastructure, core network functions, virtualized network functions, platform components, and associated operational activities, as applicable to the customer scope.
* Drive readiness reviews, pre\-checks, implementation planning, maintenance\-window coordination, testing, ATP, traffic migration, handover, and closure activities.
* Ensure that delivery teams follow approved methods of procedure, quality gates, security requirements, and operational acceptance criteria.


****Customer and stakeholder leadership****
* Act as the primary program interface for customer stakeholders, account teams, service delivery managers, technical leads, and internal executives.
* Establish a predictable communication rhythm through kickoff meetings, weekly status reviews, steering committees, risk reviews, and executive updates.
* Present concise, fact\-based views of progress, risks, decisions required, financial position, and next steps.
* Build trust by setting realistic expectations, escalating early, and ensuring that commitments are owned and followed through.
* Facilitate alignment when customer priorities, technical constraints, commercial boundaries, or delivery capacity are in tension.


**Service delivery and commercial accountability**
* Ensure contractual fulfillment and manage customer expectations throughout the upgrade lifecycle.
* Support contract establishment, renewals, service\-level commitments, and the development of the Service Level Agreement and Procedures Manual with the customer.
* Act as the escalation point for customer and internal delivery issues, ensuring timely ownership, communication, and resolution.
* Secure contract margins through disciplined cost, budget, resource, and forecast management.
* Provide inputs for resource dimensioning, capacity planning, and competence planning.
* Partner with the account team to identify, qualify, and prioritize add\-on sales and value\-creation opportunities.
* Communicate effectively with customers and ensure that actions, decisions, and commitments receive adequate follow\-up.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of Ericsson service delivery models, strategies, portfolio capabilities, and best practices.


****Risk, issue, and change management****
* Maintain an integrated RAID log covering risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
* Identify upgrade risks early, including release compatibility, lab availability, production\-readiness gaps, customer dependencies, resource constraints, service impact, and schedule compression.
* Define mitigation and contingency plans with clear owners and due dates.
* Govern scope changes through the appropriate change\-request and change\-control\-board processes.
* Protect the baseline plan and commercial position by identifying scope creep, out\-of\-scope requests, and cost or schedule impacts before commitments are made.
* Lead structured lessons\-learned reviews and ensure that improvement actions are carried into future upgrade programs.


**Financial and operational governance**
* Track program financials, forecast, resource utilization, third\-party costs, and delivery efficiency.
* Ensure that invoicing, acceptance milestones, purchase\-order dependencies, and commercial obligations are visible and actively managed.
* Drive delivery decisions that balance customer outcomes, quality, risk, time, and cost.
* Promote reuse of proven assets, standard methods, automation opportunities, and factory or delivery\-model efficiencies.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, including the project charter, integrated plan, status reports, decision log, acceptance evidence, and final report.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, business, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Typically 8–12 years of experience in telecommunications, IT infrastructure, cloud, network transformation, software delivery, or a comparable technology environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, customer\-facing programs with multiple technical workstreams and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong experience in software upgrade, network modernization, release management, migration, integration, or managed\-service delivery programs.
* Working knowledge of telecom core networks, cloud infrastructure, virtualized or containerized network functions, OSS/BSS environments, or adjacent technology domains.
* Proven experience with integrated planning, dependency management, RAID governance, change control, financial tracking, executive reporting, and customer\-facing service governance.
* Experience managing SLAs, contractual commitments, budgets, margins, escalations, and customer success outcomes is preferred.
* Experience working with structured project governance frameworks and delivery methodologies such as XLPM, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, or hybrid models.
* Program or project management certification is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

2dd7d1cb.title: Senior - Presales
2dd7d1cb.description:
**The Role**
 As a Senior Presales professional, you’ll be the bridge between customer business problems and LeadSquared’s technology .
   

  

 You’ll work with enterprise and mid\-market customers to understand their business challenges, design the right solution, and demonstrate how LeadSquared can create measurable business impact.
   

  

 From discovery and solutioning to demos, POCs, RFPs, and deal closure, you’ll play a critical role in shaping and winning complex SaaS opportunities.
   

  

 You’ll engage with CXOs, business leaders, IT teams, and other stakeholders , translating complex requirements into simple, compelling solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead customer discovery sessions to understand business objectives, processes, pain points, and technical requirements.
* Partner with Sales to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and drive solution positioning .
* Design solutions using LeadSquared across CRM, sales automation, marketing automation, workflows, integrations, and customer engagement use cases.
* Deliver impactful product demos, solution presentations, workshops, and executive conversations .
* Build POCs and customized demos for complex customer requirements.
* Own solution proposals, RFP/RFI responses, technical documentation, and solution presentations.
* Work with customers to define integrations, workflows, data flows, and implementation approaches .
* Translate product capabilities into clear business value, ROI, and customer outcomes .
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to validate solutions and ensure a smooth handover.
* Stay on top of customer needs, competitive platforms, SaaS trends, and emerging technologies.
* Build reusable demo assets, solution frameworks, and presales best practices.
* Mentor junior members of the presales team and contribute to capability building.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3–8 years of experience in SaaS Presales, Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS presales , preferably working with enterprise or mid\-market customers.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of CRM, Sales Automation, Marketing Automation, MarTech, APIs, integrations, and cloud\-based SaaS platforms .
* Proven experience with customer discovery, solution design, product demonstrations, POCs, RFPs/RFIs, and technical proposals.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXOs and senior business stakeholders .
* Ability to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into practical, scalable solutions.
* Strong commercial understanding and a consultative approach to solution selling.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Good to Have**
* Engineering degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Experience with LeadSquared or similar CRM / sales automation platforms .
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, conversational AI, workflow automation, or low\-code/no\-code platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with APIs, SQL, scripting, or integration platforms.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across multiple industries.


**What You’ll Bring**
 Customer obsession. You understand the problem before you sell the solution.
   

  

 Business thinking. You can connect technology to revenue, productivity, efficiency, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Technical depth. You can go deep with technical teams without losing sight of the business objective.
   

  

 Executive presence. You can confidently influence CXOs and senior decision\-makers.
   

  

 Ownership. You take responsibility for the opportunity from discovery through closure.
   

  

 Curiosity. You constantly look for better ways to solve customer problems and win deals.
   

  

**Why LeadSquared?**
* Work with one of India’s fastest\-growing B2B SaaS companies .
* Solve complex sales, marketing, and customer engagement challenges for leading businesses.
* Work alongside high\-performing Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams.
* Get exposure to strategic enterprise customers and complex SaaS sales cycles.
* Influence product and solution strategy through direct customer insights.
* Build your career at the intersection of technology, business, and revenue .


 If you enjoy solving complex customer problems, shaping solutions, and being a key part of winning the deal, we’d love to hear from you.

0e759ed0.title: Presales Specialist
0e759ed0.description:
**The Opportunity**




  





 As Presales Manager, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high\-value deal
 



 pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters.
 



 You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.
 



 You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.
 



 The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.
 



 You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the
 



 outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its
 



 customers.
 



 This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Prospect Understanding** 



* Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities.
* Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures.
* Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities.
* Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.



**Consultative Value Selling** 



* Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability.
* Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives.
* Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.



**Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops** 



* Conduct high\-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof\-of\-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walk through for prospective clients aligned to their business needs.
* Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic.



**RFP/RFI and Bid Support** 



* Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents.
* Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.



**Solutioning and Proposal Development** 



* Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise.
* Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs.
* Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.



**Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams** 



* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.



**Sales Enablement** 



* Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection\-handling points, customer\-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.



**Market and Customer Feedback Loop** 



* Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.



**Deal Conversion Support** 



* Actively drive the early\-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities.
* Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client\-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.



**Knowledge Management** 



* Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre\-sales productivity and consistency.



**Transition to Delivery** 



* Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer\-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.
* Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.
* Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer\-specific solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer\-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross\-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.
* Proven success in enabling high\-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

49552208.title: Solutions Engineer .
49552208.description:
Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. Solution Design \& Architecture
 



 • Engage with enterprise technology partners, software vendors, and end customers to understand their existing systems and translate requirements into a clear solution architecture.
 



 • Lead integration planning discussions, mapping data flows, defining API specifications, and aligning on technical interfaces between systems.
 



 • Produce solution design documents, architecture diagrams, and data flow maps that both technical and non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
 



 • Work with clients to design deployment configurations, on\-premise, cloud, or hybrid, based on their infrastructure constraints and performance needs.
 



 • Define compute specifications (CPU/GPU, memory, storage), network topology, and infrastructure sizing for each engagement.
 



 • Produce cloud cost estimates and total cost of ownership (TCO) models across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
 



 • Own and respond to RFPs and RFIs, including technical, security, and compliance questionnaires.
 



  





 2\. Hands\-on POC \& MVP Execution
 



 • Build working proofs of concept to validate architecture decisions before full engineering investment, including integration adapters, API bridges, and automation scripts.
 



 • Take POCs through to reference\-quality implementations where appropriate, contributing clean, maintainable code.
 



 • Document findings, limitations, and recommended next steps for every POC.
 



  





 3\. Handover \& Documentation
 



 • Create structured handover packages for product and deployment teams: runbooks, decision logs, open item trackers, and escalation paths.
 



 • Maintain a growing library of reference architectures and integration patterns as reusable assets across engagements.
 



 • Ensure nothing falls through the gap between a sales commitment and a working deployment.
 



  





 4\. Cross\-functional Technical Leadership
 



 • Act as the primary technical liaison between sales, product, engineering, and the client — translating requirements in both directions.
 



 • Identify risks early and propose pragmatic mitigations without stalling progress.
 



 • Feed deployment learnings and client signals back into CARPL's product roadmap discussions.
 



  





 Core Requirements:
 



  





 System Design \& Architecture
 



 • Solid grounding in system design, you can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and then go build it.
 



 • Familiarity with common architecture patterns: microservices, event\-driven architecture, API gateway, CQRS, pub/sub.
 



 • Understanding of how to make tradeoffs between consistency, availability, latency, and cost in real systems.
 



 • Understanding of secure design principles and data protection techniques, including encryption (at\-rest and in\-transit).
 



 • Experience designing and implementing robust access control mechanisms, such as Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), Single Sign\-On (SSO), and the principle of least privilege.
 



 • Knowledge of vulnerability management, secure coding standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10\), and integrating vulnerability testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 



  





 Hands\-on Engineering
 



 • Proficiency in at least one backend language, Python (preferred), Go, or Java, and the confidence to write production\-quality code without supervision.
 



 • Experience building REST or gRPC APIs, integration adapters, and automation scripts from scratch.
 



 • Comfortable with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and standard DevOps tooling.
 



  





 Databases
 



 • Hands\-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) — schema design, query optimisation, indexing.
 



 • Working knowledge of at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB) and when to use it.
 



 • Understanding of data modelling tradeoffs for operational vs. analytical workloads.
 



  





 Cloud \& Infrastructure
 



 • Practical experience on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including compute, storage, networking, managed services \& cloud firewall and security rules.
 



 • Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) in production or near\-production environments.
 



 • Ability to size infrastructure, estimate costs, and build a credible deployment plan for a client.
 



  





 Client\-facing \& Communication
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication: comfortable presenting architecture to a CTO or CPO and explaining tradeoffs to a developer.
 



 • Experience writing technical documentation, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, or architecture design documents.
 



 • Skilled at producing clear diagrams (Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, or similar).
 



  





 Experience
 



 • 2\+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre\-sales engineering, software engineering, or a combination.
 



 • Track record of owning end\-to\-end technical integrations with enterprise or mid\-market clients..
 



 • Experience navigating procurement cycles: security reviews, compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments.
 



  





 Preferred but not mandatory
 



 • DICOM: Working knowledge of DICOM — DIMSE services, DICOMweb (WADO/STOW/QIDO), structured reports, and DICOM node configuration.
 



 • HL7 / FHIR: Familiarity with HL7 v2 messaging and FHIR R4 resources, and how they flow between hospital systems.
 



 • PACS / VNA: Experience working with PACS, VNA, RIS, or HIS systems — ideally in an integration or deployment capacity.

77916d16.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
77916d16.description:
**Job Title**

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
**Job Description**

About IG Group


IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.


The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.


Join us at IG – the future gets built here.


**Your Team**

You’ll be joining a small, close\-knit Data platform engineering team of three to five engineers. We’re a team that takes quality seriously, looks out for each other, and gets things done without a lot of ceremony. Everyone brings something different across cloud infrastructure, data platform, and developer tooling and we rely on that range to solve problems well.


We work across time zones with colleagues in London and Kraków, so clear communication and good async habits matter. You won’t be siloed into a narrow lane in a team of this size, everyone gets exposure to the breadth of what we do, and everyone’s opinion on how we do it counts.


**Your role in the Team's Success**

In a small team, a senior hire has an outsized impact \- and this role is no different. **Here’s what success looks like:**

* You raise the floor. Your experience with GCP means the team spends less time firefighting and more time building. You bring rigour to how we design and review infrastructure, and your instinct for security and reliability makes the whole platform better.
* You unblock people. Data engineers, ML engineers, and Data teams depend on the platform to move fast. You’re the person who understands what they need, builds the right foundations, and makes sure the platform is something people trust rather than work around.
* You make the Internal Developer Platform real. An IDP is only useful if it’s kept alive and relevant. You’ll be one of the people who makes sure it reflects reality \- that services are catalogued, templates are current, and engineers across the business can actually find what they’re looking for.
* You help the team get smarter. Whether it’s sharing a better way to use AI tooling, writing a clearer runbook, or spotting a pattern we’ve been missing \- you make the people around you better at their jobs.
* You own your outcomes. This isn’t a team with heavy process or close supervision. You’ll be trusted to take work end\-to\-end, flag when something’s wrong, and drive improvements without being asked twice.
* You speak the business's language. The platform only matters if it delivers something the business can use. You'll spend real time with stakeholders across finance, compliance, BI and data science, understanding what they're trying to achieve, framing the trade\-offs in language they can act on, and translating that back into platform decisions.

The best person in this role won’t just be technically strong \- they’ll care about the team’s success as much as their own, and they’ll leave the platform in a better state than they found it.


**What you'll do**

**Responsibilities** .


* Design and architect scalable cloud infrastructure, developing IaC solutions using Terraform and standardisation initiatives
* Build, optimise, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, supporting DevOps and DevSecOps best practices across the organisation
* Operate and evolve GCP data platform services \- BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub \- in close collaboration with data and ML engineering teams
* Support IAM, service account design, and security posture across the platform, enforcing least\-privilege principles
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for platform issues, and drive improvements to reduce recurrence
* Participate in an on\-call rota as the platform's operational coverage matures.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of our IDP \- adding catalog entries, improving scaffolder templates, and keeping TechDocs accurate
* Work with data engineering and ML engineering teams to onboard their services and pipelines into the catalog, ensuring ownership and metadata are correctly represented
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools \- including Claude Code \- as part of your daily workflow for infrastructure authoring, code review, and documentation
* Share effective AI patterns and prompting approaches with the team, helping build a culture of thoughtful, safe AI\-augmented engineering

**What you'll need for this role**

**You’ll need solid experience in:**

* 8\+ years in cloud infrastructure engineering with hands\-on experience designing and administering complex platforms in GCP including working knowledge of networking (VPC, VPCSC, Direct Connect) and IaaS/PaaS architectural patterns.
* Designing and operating Google Cloud Platform \- BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub \- at production scale
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform, with real hands\-on experience of multi\-environment configuration management across cloud providers
* GitLab CI/CD \- building and maintaining pipelines, runners, and merge request workflows
* Cloud IAM and access control design, with a clear understanding of least\-privilege and security best practices
* Working collaboratively with data or ML engineering teams as a platform provider \- not just building infrastructure, but making it usable
* A consultative approach. You're comfortable working with non\-technical stakeholders, interpreting requirements, challenging assumptions where needed, and influencing outcomes without retreating into jargon.

**It would be a bonus (but not essential) if you have:**

* AWS exposure
* Backstage experience \- software catalog configuration, scaffolder templates, or plugin development
* Familiarity with data platform concepts \- medallion architecture, lakehouse patterns, or orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt
* Exposure managing Databricks
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) in a professional engineering context
* Experience working in regulated financial services environments

**The Perks**

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.


* Matched giving for your fundraising activity
* Flexible working hours and work\-from\-home opportunities
* Performance\-related bonuses
* Insurance and medical plans
* Career\-focused technical and leadership training in\-class and online, incl. unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning platform
* Contribution to gym memberships and more
* Free Lunch/Snacks/Fruits
* A day off on your birthday
* Two days’ volunteering leave per year.

  



**Number of openings**

1

 Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP\-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. **Role:AWS Connect Technical Architect** 




**Exp: 10\+ years** 




**Location: Remote** 




**Job Overview:** 




 The role has the accountabilities of owning the end\-to\-end solution architecture for cloud\-based Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) engagements built on
 **Amazon Connect** 
 and the AWS ecosystem — from solutioning and design through governance, delivery oversight and client advisory across engagements.
 



  





**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for Amazon Connect\-based CCaaS engagements, from discovery through go\-live
* Define target\-state architecture covering Contact Flows, routing strategy, channel strategy (voice, chat, email, social) and data/reporting architecture
* Architect integrations of Amazon Connect with the broader AWS and enterprise ecosystem, including:
* **AWS Lambda, Amazon Lex/Lex v2, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon Connect Customer Profiles \& Cases, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, and third\-party CRM/WFM/Salesforce/ServiceNow platforms**
* Define non\-functional requirements — scalability, high availability, multi\-region disaster recovery, security and compliance (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR as applicable)
* Own technical governance — define coding standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks and best practices across delivery teams
* Lead solution design workshops with client stakeholders, translating business and CX objectives into robust technical architectures
* Produce and own High\-Level Design (HLD), Low\-Level Design (LLD), architecture decision records and technical proposals
* Lead migration strategy and execution for legacy/on\-premise or other CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys, Avaya, Cisco) to Amazon Connect
* Drive capacity planning, cost optimization and TCO analysis for Amazon Connect deployments
* Provide pre\-sales support — solution estimation, RFP/RFI responses, architecture diagrams and client presentations
* Guide and mentor development and senior development teams; conduct architecture and design reviews
* Own security architecture, IAM design, data privacy controls and telephony architecture (SIP trunking, PSTN, DID, carrier strategy)
* Act as the primary technical escalation point and advisor to client stakeholders, including CX and IT leadership
* Stay current with Amazon Connect and AWS roadmap, and proactively recommend platform and architecture enhancements



  





**Key Capabilities and Experience** 



* 8–10 years of overall IT experience, with at least 4–5 years in architecting and delivering Amazon Connect / CCaaS solutions
* Proven track record of leading multiple end\-to\-end Amazon Connect implementations as solution/technical architect
* Expert\-level understanding of contact center operations, omni\-channel CX architecture and CX/operational metrics
* Strong expertise in conversational AI (Amazon Lex) and generative AI capabilities within the Amazon Connect ecosystem (Amazon Q in Connect)
* Deep expertise in serverless and cloud\-native architecture across the AWS ecosystem (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, EventBridge, Kinesis)
* Strong grounding in telephony architecture — SIP, VoIP, PSTN, DID provisioning and carrier integration strategy
* Extensive experience architecting integrations with CRM, WFM and enterprise systems via REST/SOAP APIs and event\-driven patterns
* Strong understanding of security, compliance and data privacy frameworks relevant to contact center platforms
* Experience with Contact Lens analytics, Amazon QuickSight and enterprise reporting/BI architecture
* Demonstrated experience in pre\-sales, proposal writing and client/executive stakeholder management
* Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring architects and developers, and driving technical governance across teams
* Experience operating within agile/scaled\-agile delivery environments and leading cross\-functional delivery teams



  





**Qualifications** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT or related technical fields
* AWS Certification (Solutions Architect – Professional / Amazon Connect specialty) – Preferred

957e183f.description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will take on the role of IT SAP FICO Solution Architect, supporting and guiding initiatives across the global financial systems landscape by designing robust and scalable SAP FI/CO solutions that build on existing platforms. Your expertise in accounting and SAP FI/CO processes enables you to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality concepts that strengthen global financial processes.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with project teams, business stakeholders, and IT colleagues to review functional designs, validate data flows, and ensure new solutions integrate seamlessly with SAP ECC, S/4HANA, consolidation tools, and treasury systems. A significant part of your day will be spent supporting initiatives across countries and ERP environments, harmonizing processes, and ensuring local requirements align with global standards. You will identify improvement opportunities, uncover automation potential, and assess where AI\-driven enhancements can add value while maintaining operational stability.
   

  

 You will also contribute to strengthening in\-house capabilities by coaching colleagues, sharing best practices, and enabling teams to deliver high\-value use cases. Through your work, you will help mature the SAP and finance community while shaping high\-impact solutions within a global environment.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Drive end\-to\-end SAP FI data\-driven reporting initiatives from preparation and conception through realization and Go Live, covering both transactional and consolidated data.
* Lead multiple projects and operational tasks in parallel, ensuring smooth execution across a complex system landscape.
* Perform deep SAP FI data analysis to validate data quality, strengthen configurations, and support informed decision\-making.
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder meetings, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Build and expand in\-house expertise across SAP ERP, treasury, and consolidation systems to enable delivery of high\-value use cases.
* Champion global process harmonization by aligning country\-specific and ERP\-specific processes within a unified architecture that drives consistency and scalability.
* Identify redundancies and evaluate opportunities for AI\-driven automation, presenting strategic proposals to enhance efficiency and accelerate innovation.
* Bring forward creative ideas and practical solutions to complex challenges, fostering continuous improvement.
* Stay adaptable and resilient in the face of shifting priorities, ambiguity, and tight deadlines while continuously developing professional capabilities.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Finance, Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field; qualifications such as ACCA, CA, CIMA, CMA, or MBA\-Finance are preferred.
* More than five years of experience in a consulting environment or within the IT organization of a global company or comparable enterprise delivering SAP\-focused implementation and support services.
* Strong understanding of financial business processes and extensive hands\-on expertise in SAP FI configuration.
* Solid experience integrating SAP FI and SAP CO with other SAP modules to ensure seamless end\-to\-end process flows.
* Experience working with virtual, globally distributed teams in international project environments.
* Proven project\-leading experience in S/4HANA implementation initiatives.
* High customer orientation, strong service mindset, and the business acumen to translate requirements into effective solutions.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills that support collaboration and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong writing, mentoring, decision\-making, and facilitation capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide colleagues to ensure high\-quality project outcomes and consulting services.

a10e7843.description:
**Overview**
 As a
 **Solution Architect** 
 at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.
   

  

 We are looking for a developing Solution Architect who enjoys design work, stakeholder engagement, and turning delivery activity into supportable services. This role is suited to someone who has already contributed to solution designs and wants to further build their architecture career across cloud, service transition, vendor delivery, and operational readiness. It is not a hands\-on engineering role; the focus is on design quality by ensuring effective documentation, governance, vendor engagement, and ensuring new services can be successfully supported after go\-live by effective design.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**In this role you will:**
* Support the design of new IT services across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through to build review, release readiness, handover, and early\-life support.
* Embed non\-functional requirements into solution designs, including availability, capacity, performance, security, monitoring, disaster recovery, recoverability, etc.
* Produce, review, and maintain design documentation, ensuring solutions are clearly described, traceable to requirements, and suitable for transition into IT support.
* Produce and review architecture artefacts including solution designs, architecture diagrams, and design decisions to support delivery and operational readiness.
* Assess vendor and internal delivery artefacts to confirm alignment with approved designs, cloud standards, security expectations, and operational requirements.
* Review handover materials, including operational documentation, monitoring and alerting requirements, service mapping, support models, and service readiness artefacts.
* Support the preparation, as the design SME, the release readiness packs, support hypercare planning, manage hypercare exit criteria, and ensure a clean handover to IT Support.
* Participate in CCoE, CAB, design reviews, release readiness reviews, post\-incident reviews, and other governance forums.
* Act as the interlock between functional teams, product owners, vendors, internal subject matter experts, and IT support teams.
* Support incident and problem management where design input is required, helping identify whether issues relate to design gaps, documentation gaps, integration issues, or weak handover.
* Contribute to policies, procedures, and delivery standards with the Enterprise Architect and Data Architect, with a focus on making them practical and usable across delivery and support.
* Improve delivery and handover practices by supporting the standardising of templates,
* improving documentation quality, and raising the operability of new IT services.
* Ensure knowledge capture, clear service mapping, and up\-to\-date documentation in agreed repositories.


**We would love to hear from you if you:**
* Have 5 to 8 years’ experience primarily in solution architecture, technical design, or a developing Solution Architect type roles.
* Can show evidence of producing, contributing to, or reviewing solution designs, architecture diagrams, and design documentation, rather than solely delivering hands\-on engineering activity, plus can show understanding of the importance of traceable designs, support models, runbooks, monitoring requirements, service mapping, and clean handover into operational teams.
* Have good Azure cloud knowledge, including integration patterns, security, and operational support considerations.
* Have experience working across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design documentation, vendor engagement, build review, release readiness, handover, and early\-life support.
* Can engage well with vendors, product owners, functional teams, architects, support teams, and technical subject matter experts.
* Can challenge constructively when requirements are unclear, documentation is incomplete, or a solution is not ready to transition into support.
* Are detail\-oriented, quality\-focused, and comfortable assessing whether documentation is complete, understandable, and fit for delivery \& support use.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and can explain design decisions in plain language


**Nice to have:**
* Have or are working towards relevant cloud certifications, ideally Azure certifications such as AZ\-305 or equivalent cloud certifications
* Have knowledge of other Cloud Hosting platforms such as Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services
* Have experience using Jira and Confluence, and/or Azure DevOps, to track delivery activity, document decisions, manage actions, and maintain knowledge.
* Ideally have familiarity with security and compliance practices such as ISO 27001\.
* Have working knowledge of Azure FinOps \& Policy Management
* Exposure to Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, or other enterprise SaaS platforms and enterprise integration patterns, or middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, or modern cloud delivery practices.


 All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.
   

  

**About Us**
 Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy. With Linesight, you can truly discover the power of team!
   

  

 Diversity, inclusion and accessibility
   

  

 Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. We are building a diverse and inclusive organisation, accessible to all, based on having a safe culture which enables all our people to be their true selves. We are a people business, and we understand that the more inclusive we are, the happier our people and better our work will be. We will ensure that individuals with disability are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or recruitment process and are accommodated in the workplace. If you require assistance or accommodation of any kind, please mention this in your application, we would love to hear from you!

78ac9ed0.description:
**Technical Delivery Manager**
 Who We Are
   

  

 Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI\-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data\-driven energy\-related decisions. Ranked \#7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future.
   

  

 What We Do
   

  

 Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data—such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions—into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity, and beyond.
   

  

 How We Do It
   

  

 From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely advances smart meter innovation with data\-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short\-term load forecasting, grid analytics, and time\-of\-use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAI™ platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value\-added products and services.
   

  

 For more information, please visit:
   

  

* Website: www.bidgely.com
* Blog: bidgely.com/blog


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Delivery Manager to head a cross\-functional team in implementing and configuring our product solutions for enterprise\-level clients. This role demands extensive technical leadership, people management, and project ownership skills, ensuring thorough quality checks and leading innovative approaches (e.g., GenAI, automation) to streamline delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with internal engineering, R\&D, QA, and support teams, receiving high\-level, outcome\-based requirements from our Technical Program Managers.

* Foster a culture that values ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.


 Senior\-Level Project Delivery
   

  

* Translate complex, outcome\-driven requirements from Technical Program Managers into comprehensive project roadmaps and execution plans.
* Oversee multiple, concurrent implementation projects—coordinating internal teams to ensure timely, budget\-conscious, and high\-quality releases.

* Establish and uphold rigorous quality controls, encompassing functionality, data integrity, performance, and user acceptance criteria.

 Process Optimization \& Automation
   

  

* Identify and implement strategic improvements to reduce manual effort, boost delivery speed, and maintain consistent quality across projects.
* Promote documentation, best practices, and standardized procedures to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Leverage metrics, analytics, and user feedback to iterate on processes and evolve best\-in\-class delivery methodologies.


**Requirements**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in software delivery, implementation, or technical program/project management, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional projects in fast\-paced or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS) is a plus.


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Demonstrated proficiency in software configuration, integration APIs, data pipelines, debugging, and system performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience tackling complex technical issues at both application and data levels.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI).


 Leadership \& Communication
   

  

* Strong background in leading and mentoring high\-performing technical teams, including architects, senior developers, and QA leads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of interfacing with executive\-level audiences.
* Adept at guiding cross\-functional groups toward common goals and managing change in a dynamic environment.


 Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Experience in the energy or utilities sector is beneficial, but not required.
* Ability to adapt rapidly to evolving industry trends and new technologies.


 Equal Opportunity Statement
   

  

 Bidgely is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are serious about and embrace diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills to build a better future and a better workforce.

f9f80030.title: Staff Program Manager – Expert Readiness & Engagement (India)
f9f80030.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, our global network of thousands of tax, bookkeeping, and financial experts is the human intelligence (HI) that powers our AI\-driven financial technology platform. This position is a critical regional leadership role within Intuit's Expert Network, focused on the expert brand, operational readiness, change management, and engagement of our India\-based expert community.

  

As the Staff Program Manager of Expert Readiness \& Engagement (India), you will serve as the essential connective tissue between our global product/experience strategies and our local Indian expert footprint. Your mission is to ensure that when new technology, workflows, or product updates are introduced, the India network is 100% prepared to execute flawlessly. You will focus inward — architecting site branding, driving localized engagement strategies, managing internal communication, and leading regional change management frameworks. By leveraging continuous listening loops, you will ensure our India expert community is trained, equipped, and culturally aligned to deliver delight to our global customers.

 **Responsibilities**

*Lead Regional Change Management \& Expert Readiness*

* Deployment Orchestration: Act as the strategic partner to central expert readiness and change management and corresponding COEs for global tool deployments and product releases. Own the regional readiness roadmap for India, mapping out dependencies, training timelines, and process variations
* Impact \& Friction Assessment: Conduct change impact assessments to understand how global platform updates uniquely affect the Indian workforce. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks before deployment
* Adoption Tracking \& Hypercare: Define and monitor tool adoption metrics. Lead post\-launch "hypercare" support structures locally to quickly address technical glitches or operational confusion during critical peak seasons

*Establish Local Listening Infrastructure \& Process Rigor*

* Gemba \& Observational Studies: Establish a disciplined cadence of "Gemba" walks and workflow shadowing to observe real\-time tool usage, capturing friction points that quantitative metrics might miss
* Continuous Feedback Loops: Set up regional listening posts and pulse\-survey frameworks tailored to capture the daily sentiment, technical health, and overall tools readiness of the India network
* Insights\-to\-Action Root Cause Analysis: Partner with the global Expert Voice \& Insights team to translate local workflow friction into structured, data\-backed business requirements for the core product engineering backlog

*Drive Internal Engagement, Site Experience, and Communications*

  

* Strategic Communication Alignment: Manage regional internal communication channels, translating complex technical rollouts and global updates into clear, actionable, and culturally contextualized narratives for our experts
* Site Identity \& Brand Advocacy: Partner with local facilities and global creative stakeholders to guide physical and virtual site branding, creating a workplace environment that fosters deep brand pride and a unified mission
* Culture of Excellence: Design and scale localized engagement initiatives that boost community belonging, maintain high engagement scores, and celebrate "magic moments" where experts leverage AI to delight customers

 **Qualifications**

*Experience \& Change Management Domain Expertise*

* 8–10\+ years of experience leading Program Management, Change Management, or Operational Excellence initiatives within a global technology company or a highly scaled Global Capability Center (GCC) in India
* Change Management Frameworks: Direct expertise applying structured change methodologies; Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or equivalent credentials preferred
* Rollout Architecture: Proven history of successfully landing complex, multi\-stakeholder software migrations or tool deployments across a large workforce of distributed users
* Operational Listening: Deep familiarity with setting up workforce feedback loops, executing Gemba\-style observational studies, and parsing qualitative feedback into structured data

*Leadership \& Influence*

  

* Cross\-Border Autonomy: Exceptional ability to operate as a self\-driven regional anchor, managing local delivery while maintaining matrixed alignment with a global cross\-functional team in the US
* Stakeholder Management: Strong capability to navigate tension between global tech timelines and local operational realities, advocating fiercely for the expert experience while respecting product launch goals
* Strategic Communications: Elite verbal, written, and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to synthesize highly technical changes into intuitive, empathetic workforce communications

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful

* Experience running meetings and maintaining delivery artifacts using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Google Workspace, or equivalent tools.

* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, or approved internal AI assistants to improve productivity, communication quality, meeting summaries, documentation, risk identification, and decision support.
* Define program strategy while trying to find direction from peers or managers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in Data \& Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Finance Analytics, or cloud data platform organizations.
* Experience supporting programs involving Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Power BI, Airflow, Python, or similar data engineering technologies.
* Experience working with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer, or Product data domains.
* Experience managing release readiness, production launch planning, dependency management, or enterprise\-scale delivery coordination.
* Experience creating executive\-level program updates, dashboards, delivery scorecards, or operational reporting.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, AWS, Snowflake, dbt, or other relevant certifications.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

efe11d06.title: Head – Pre-Sales & Solution Strategy
efe11d06.description:
Job Type
Full Time

**Location:** Bangalore, India (Hybrid)


**Reporting to:** Managing Director


### **Role Overview**


A hands\-on leadership role, not a managerial one. You will independently lead pre\-sales and solution strategy, owning everything from solution and architecture to RFP responses, PoCs, and customer presentations. You will work closely with sales, delivery, product, and leadership teams. A startup mindset is highly preferred.

* Own end\-to\-end RFP / RFQ / EOI / Government tender and enterprise bid responses
* Prepare technical proposals, compliance matrices, architecture diagrams, implementation methodologies, and scope definitions
* Build and deliver customer presentations, solution decks, demos, and PoCs

* Evaluate emerging technologies AI, Cloud, Open Source, Digital Government, Enterprise Automation

**About the role**
 Cognizant is looking for a Presales and Bid Manager to drive winning pursuits across our Data, Analytics, and AI business. In this role you will shape compelling client\-facing proposals, orchestrate pursuit activities end to end, and partner with sales, delivery, and solution teams to bring our best thinking to every opportunity. * Support opportunity qualification, account intelligence, and client research activities to strengthen every pursuit.
* Develop proposal content, presentations, response documents, and sales collateral that clearly articulate value.
* Coordinate pursuit activities, reviews, governance checkpoints, and submission timelines across stakeholders.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into compelling client\-facing content.
* Experience supporting RFPs, proposals, presentations, capability decks, and client research activities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.


**These will help you stand out**
* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders across sales, delivery, and solution teams and manage pursuit processes in a structured manner.

* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

30431c58.title: Presales & Solutioning Lead – CRE, Connected Factory, Data Centre
30431c58.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated Presales \& Solutioning Lead to act as the techno\-commercial bridge between Ecolibrium's business development team and enterprise customers across commercial real estate (CRE), connected factories and data centres. The role will lead discovery, design solution architectures and drive proof\- of\-concepts and pilots that demonstrate quantifiable value, including energy savings, uptime improvement and maintenance cost reduction, across discrete and process industries.
 



  





 The Presales \& Solutioning Lead will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Procurement to translate customer requirements into robust technical solutions, proposals and implementation plans, and will lead technical selling through to deal close alongside the sales team. This is a hands\-on presales role requiring strong technical solutioning, stakeholder management, commercial acumen and the ability to simplify complex Industry 4\.0 concepts for business audiences, and requires 8–10 years of relevant experience.
 



  





**THE WORK** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Lead site walkthroughs, stakeholder workshops and requirement deep\-dives across production, maintenance, energy and IT/OT teams in CRE, connected factory and data centre environments.
 



 • Build ROI/TCO models with clear KPIs, including power reduction, demand optimisation, asset uptime and MTBF/MTTR improvement across electrical, mechanical and workplace solutions.
 



 • Apply working knowledge of HVAC and mechanical controls concepts across CRE, manufacturing and retail environments.
 



 • Design end\-to\-end solutions spanning sensors/gateways, connectivity, AI/ML analytics and dashboards.
 



 • Configure and deliver tailored demos, and plan and run PoCs/pilots with defined success criteria, test plans and acceptance gates.
 



 • Produce SoWs, solution architecture documents, BoMs/sizing, integration architecture diagrams and pricing inputs to support the sales team.
 



 • Lead technical selling and solution walkthroughs with the client from the second round of discussion through to deal close, alongside the sales team.
 



 • Lead RFI/RFP responses, compliance matrices and technical due diligence.• Assess existing monitoring tools and define integrations with EMS/BMS/SCADA/MES/ERP/CMMS and
 



 historians (e.g. PI, Ignition), using protocols including OPC UA, Modbus/TCP, BACnet, MQTT and API integration.
 



 • Collaborate with the product and data science teams to align use cases such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance and energy baseline modelling/M\&V.
 



 • Work with clients on site to identify exact requirements and integration gaps for new products.
 



 • Apply hands\-on experience solutioning control solutions for HVAC high\-side and low\-side systems.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to plant managers, facility heads, data centre managers, operational heads, energy managers, reliability/maintenance, IT/OT security and procurement stakeholders.
 



 • Ensure clean handover to delivery teams with documented architecture, KPIs and implementation plans.
 



 • Coordinate between the Sales, PMO and Procurement teams for smooth project execution.
 



 • Collaborate with the sales team on custom site requirements and solution customisation.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Essential** 




 • Engineering degree or Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Industrial Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
 



 • 8–10 years of relevant experience in presales, solution consulting or technical sales within Industrial IoT, Energy Management Systems or condition\-based monitoring for manufacturing/facilities.
 



 • Solid understanding of the Industry 4\.0 stack, including sensors, gateways, edge, cloud, time\-series data, streaming analytics and eventing.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with one or more industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, BACnet, MQTT, SNMP) and gateway configuration.
 



 • Working knowledge of HVAC control systems (high\-side and low\-side), gained through hands\-on solutioning experience.
 



 • Demonstrated experience running PoCs/pilots in plant environments and working comfortably within site conditions and OT constraints.
 



 • Experience building business cases for energy savings, demand optimisation and maintenance outcomes.
 



 • Familiarity with AI/ML industrial use cases and SaaS delivery models, including multi\-tenant architecture, APIs, dashboards and alerting/workflows.
 



 • Knowledge of energy standards and measurement \& verification frameworks (ISO 50001, IPMVP, ASHRAE).
 



 • Excellent communication, whiteboarding and proposal\-writing skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business stakeholders.
 



  





**Desirable** 




 • Exposure to BMS, EMS, historians, digital twins or power quality/HVAC optimisation.
 



 • Experience across the APAC manufacturing market and within partner ecosystems (SIs/OEMs).

d48c5f07.title: Solution Area Specialists Windows & Devices
d48c5f07.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to
 **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem** 
 , the
 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
   

  

 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based \& differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand\-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8\+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.
* Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.
* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud\-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of AI\-ready Windows devices, including Copilot\+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next\-generation endpoint strategies.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

**SAINTS \& MASTERS PVT LTD.** 




**Senior AWS Solutions Architect** 




*Pre\-Sales Solutioning \& Delivery Enablement*

 Kochi, Kerala, India (Work from Home)
 



**Function:** 
 Cloud Solutioning / Pre\-Sales Engineering
 



**Experience:** 
 8 to 12 years
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior AWS Solutions Architect to join our cloud practice in Kochi. This is a customer\-facing, solutioning\-focused role that sits at the intersection of pre\-sales and delivery. You will work alongside the AWS field team to identify where AWS can add value for our customers, shape technical solutions, and translate business needs into practical, well\-architected proposals.
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technologist with a strong development background who has moved deeper into the AWS stack, with particular strength in AWS AI services and agent\-based solutions. You will not only design solutions but also help validate effort estimates and ensure a smooth handover to the delivery teams who build them.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Pre\-Sales \& Customer Solutioning** 



* Partner with the AWS account and field teams to identify opportunities and areas where AWS services can solve customer problems.
* Lead technical discovery conversations with customers, understand their business and technical challenges, and map them to AWS solutions.
* Design and present solution architectures, proofs of concept, and technical proposals that are secure, scalable, and cost\-aware.
* Communicate the value of proposed solutions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision makers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires, and support commercial discussions with well\-reasoned technical inputs.



**AI Services \& Agent Development** 



* Design and build agent\-based solutions on AWS, using services such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, and Amazon Q, with hands\-on experience across the agent lifecycle.
* Apply AWS AI and machine learning services (for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker AI, Amazon Textract, Comprehend, Transcribe, and Rekognition) to real customer use cases.
* Develop working prototypes and demos that showcase generative AI and agentic capabilities to customers.
* Stay current with the rapidly evolving AWS AI and generative AI landscape and advise customers on suitable, practical approaches.



**Data Solutions** 



* Bring a working understanding of the AWS data landscape, including storage, databases, analytics, and data pipelines (for example Amazon S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Glue, and Athena).
* Advise on how data solutions underpin AI workloads and factor data readiness into overall solution design.



**Application Development \& Engineering** 



* Draw on solid software development and application\-building experience to design solutions that are realistic to build and maintain.

**Delivery Collaboration \& Handover** 



* Work closely with the delivery teams to review and validate effort estimates against the proposed scope.
