* Experience drafting Statements of Work and technical proposals
* Experience of working as a liaison between Sales and an Engineering team
* Able to manage technical solutions by performing basic project management functions including but not limited to scope, tracking deliverables, providing meeting minutes and tracking action items
* Experience with scripting or programming languages for adapting or creating demo environments
* Hands\-on experience with development platforms or compilers (Android Studio, Visual Studio, etc.)
* Proven ability to configure, test, and validate server/client systems
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Familiarity with biometric systems (fingerprint, facial)
* Experience with Enterprise and distributed system architecture
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and virtualization/containerization tools (VMware, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with collaboration and productivity tools: Salesforce, Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Git
* Strong teamwork abilities and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Solid experience working within an MS Windows 11 environment


**Why apply?**
* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part\-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results\-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

 HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. a5e739c7.description:
**Description**  



  

### **About Norstella**

  

 Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life\-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.  

  

Norstella unites market\-leading brands \- Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must\-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision\-making. We help our clients:  

* Accelerate the drug development cycle
* Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market
* Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
* Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
* Identify and address barriers to therapies


  

Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI\-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.  

### **Job Summary**


We are seeking a hands\-on Salesforce Architect / Engineer to lead the design, implementation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360\) and Marketing Cloud Engagement. This is a hybrid role that blends architectural thinking with deep, practical engineering — the right person is equally comfortable defining a scalable data and activation architecture and rolling up their sleeves to build, configure, and operate it day to day.


You will own these two platforms end to end: standing them up, integrating them with the broader Salesforce ecosystem and external systems, configuring data models and customer journeys, and keeping them healthy and performant over time. The ideal candidate has proven, hands\-on experience setting up and configuring both Data Cloud (Data 360\) and Marketing Cloud Engagement, and can move fluidly between strategic solution design and direct implementation

### **Responsibilities**

  

**1**. **Data Cloud (Data 360\) – Architecture \& Implementation**

* Design and implement the Data Cloud (Data 360\) data architecture, including data streams, data lake objects, data model objects (DMOs), and the canonical customer data model.
* Set up and configure data ingestion from Salesforce CRM, Marketing Cloud, and external sources using connectors, ingestion APIs, and batch/streaming pipelines.
* Build and maintain identity resolution rulesets, matching and reconciliation rules, and unified profiles.
* Create calculated insights, segments, and activations to power marketing, sales, and service use cases.
* Configure data governance, consent, and privacy controls to ensure compliant use of customer data.
* Optimize data model performance, storage, and processing costs as data volumes scale.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement – Architecture \& Implementation
* Set up and configure Marketing Cloud Engagement, including business units, data extensions, contact model, and sender/authentication configuration.
* Design and build customer journeys in Journey Builder, including triggered, multi\-step, and data\-driven journeys.
* Develop email, SMS, and push content using Content Builder, AMPscript, SSJS, and dynamic/personalized content.
* Configure and maintain Automation Studio activities, SQL queries against data extensions, file transfers, and scheduled processes.
* Implement and manage the integration between Data Cloud (Data 360\) and Marketing Cloud Engagement for segmentation and activation.
* Manage subscriber data, preference and consent management, deliverability, and sending reputation.

**3**. **Architecture, Integration \& Development**

* Define the overall solution architecture connecting Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud Engagement, Salesforce core clouds, and external systems.
* Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and middleware tools.
* Develop custom solutions where declarative configuration is insufficient, using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), AMPscript, and SSJS.
* Make and document architectural decisions for multi\-cloud, data, and security models, balancing scalability, maintainability, and cost.
* Establish coding, configuration, and naming standards, and enforce best practices across the platforms.

**4\. Configuration \& Ongoing Maintenance**

* Own the day\-to\-day configuration of both Data Cloud (Data 360\) and Marketing Cloud Engagement.
* Customize standard and custom objects, fields, data extensions, and data model objects to meet evolving business needs.
* Implement and maintain security controls, including user roles, profiles, permissions, sharing, and business unit access.
* Monitor and optimize platform performance, data quality, and processing throughput.
* Conduct regular system audits and proactively manage technical debt to ensure long\-term platform health.
* Review Salesforce, Data Cloud, and Marketing Cloud release notes, identifying risks to current builds and features that could benefit the organization.

**5\. Collaboration \& Problem Solving**

* Work closely with Salesforce admins, marketing operations, data teams, business stakeholders, and product owners to gather and analyze requirements.
* Propose technical solutions aligned with business objectives and translate them into working implementations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data, journey, deliverability, and performance issues across both platforms.
* Lead technical workshops and solution design sessions for complex data and activation use cases.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor on Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud strategy and roadmap.

**6\. Documentation \& Best Practices**

* Document data models, architecture, integrations, journeys, and configuration details.
* Establish and maintain architectural standards, governance frameworks, and documentation protocols.
* Adhere to Salesforce best practices to ensure maintainability and scalability.
* Mentor admins, developers, and marketing operations staff to build internal capability and ensure knowledge transfer.

### **Requirements :**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven, hands\-on experience setting up and configuring Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360\) — including data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation.
* Proven, hands\-on experience setting up and configuring Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement — including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, and the contact/data extension model.
* Strong experience implementing the integration and activation flow between Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud Engagement.
* Proficiency in AMPscript, SSJS, and SQL (for data extensions), plus Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Knowledge of Salesforce integrations using REST, SOAP, and other APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to operate at both an architectural level (solution design, data modeling, governance) and an engineering level (build, configure, maintain).
* Understanding of data governance, consent, and customer data privacy requirements.
* Salesforce certifications such as Data Cloud Consultant, Marketing Cloud Developer, Marketing Cloud Consultant, Marketing Cloud Engagement Email Specialist, Platform Developer I/II, or Application/System Architect.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git, and DevOps practices and tools such as Salesforce DX, Jenkins, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
* Experience with multi\-business\-unit Marketing Cloud configurations and enterprise\-scale data volumes.
* Experience with adjacent Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service) and broader marketing/data technology stacks.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking, with the ability to design and then build the solution.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills across technical and marketing audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and a proactive, ownership\-driven approach to platform health and improvement.
* Comfort moving between strategy and hands\-on execution as the work demands.

2aadee67.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
2aadee67.description:
**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

d1fdaefa.title: Senior Cloud Solutions Architect
d1fdaefa.description:
**Job Title:** 
**Senior Cloud Solution Architect**
**Location: Bangalore**
**About Unilever**
 With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.
   

  

 At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.
   

  

**About Gdt**
 GDT is the global digital and technology engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. GDT serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.
   

  

**Business Context and Main Purpose of the Role**
 Unilever’s modern technology strategy focuses on accelerated digital transformation, AI\-driven value creation, sustainability, and a Product\-Centric operating model. The Cloud Platform Services (CPS) organisation plays a key role in enabling this strategy by delivering secure, scalable, automated, and cost‑efficient cloud platforms across our major Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) platforms. The Senior Cloud Solution Architect guides platform modernisation, AI‑ready architectures, FinOps maturity, automation expansion, and adoption of Unilever’s new operating framework built around product lines and value streams.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally with Global Digital Technology and partners to guide our customers on their cloud journey, listening and understanding their business requirement and helping design or advise them on the most appropriate cloud architecture for them. You will work closely work with our delivery partners and leading technology partners to ensure that systems are built to Unilevers exacting standards for security and availability ensuring that the Solution Architectures created satisfy customer’s requirements.
   

  

**Main Accountabilities**
* Partner with Cloud Services Engagement (CSE) teams and Product Line Owners to design cloud‑native, AI‑enabled architectures aligned to Unilever’s technology strategy and modern operating framework.
* Drive adoption of reusable cloud patterns, platform accelerators, automation frameworks, and best‑practice landing zones supporting Unilever’s product‑based delivery model.
* Lead technical discovery and value‑identification workshops with senior stakeholders across UniOps, Markets, and Platform teams to shape modernisation roadmaps.
* Ensure architectures align to security‑by‑design, FinOps, automation principles, resilience engineering, and responsible AI practices.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Teams, and Enterprise Architecture to translate business outcomes into cloud service capabilities and multi‑year roadmaps.
* Coach teams on cloud adoption, AI enablement, and modern engineering standards; contribute to capability building across CPS and wider UniOps.


**Key Skills And Relevant Experience**
**Skills \& Experience:**
* Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex technical concepts to senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of cloud‑native architecture, AI Hosting considerations, automation, security, and FinOps operating principles.
* Demonstrated experience influencing technology strategy across technology teams, geographies, and cross‑functional groups.
* Strong customer‑centric mindset and ability to identify business value through cloud solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engagements and align technical outcomes to enterprise‑level frameworks and strategies.
* 5\+ years as a Cloud Advisor or Senior Architect working with major CSPs (GCP, Azure).


**Minimum Qualifications**
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ‑305\)
* Architecture and Governance certifications (ITIL, CISSP, TOGAF beneficial)
* Experience with Agile, DevOps, modern engineering tooling (GitHub, CI/CD, IaC, JIRA)


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Experience of using JIRA and other agile design toolsets, including any appropriate Agile methodology certifications (e.g. Scrum)


**BEHAVIOURS**
 Candidates would be required to show demonstration of the following behaviours:
   

  

* Accountability and Ownership \- Strive for high quality and success, empower yourself and others to make decisions.
* Be bold \- Challenge the status quo, be bold \& passionate about technology, think outside of the box and be willing to improve.
* Customer First \- Thinking about our customers constantly by providing them with the best tools, services and end user experiences.
* Collaboration \- Working in an openly creative culture, where all ideas are acknowledged encouraging innovation and transparency.
* Empowered \- Always be one step ahead, embrace change and challenges, initiate solutions and make decisions in good faith.


**Leadership Skills**
* CARE DEEPLY: We care about how consumers experience our brands, the growth and development of our people, and their impact on the planet. We emphasize the importance of performance and care, moving from ambiguity about success to fairness and transparency.
* FOCUS ON WHAT COUNTS: We prioritize what truly matters, setting clear and stretching goals. We aim to shift from having everything as a priority to focusing on fewer, bigger things that are delivered to conclusion and are being rewarded.
* STAY THREE STEPS AHEAD: We encourage bold and creative thinking to make breakthroughs in performance. We focus on anticipating and staying ahead of consumer needs and external trends, shifting from reacting to leading, shaping, and disrupting the market.
* DELIVER WITH EXCELLENCE: The emphasis is on delivering everything with excellence and pace, taking personal ownership, and holding each other accountable. We aim to shift from pride in thinking to pride in execution, developing breakthrough solutions and ensuring the best outcomes.


**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion**
* Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

0c1d9e67.title: Oracle SaaS Cloud Security - Consultant
0c1d9e67.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

 Enterprise Security:
   

  

 Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end\-to\-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration \& Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement.
   

  

 Level: Consultant
   

  

 Work you’ll do:
   

  

 As a Consultant, you will be supporting the team/clients with their Cyber needs specifically helping them address Application Security concerns and navigate the journey on the Oracle Platform. This will include:
   

  

* Design, and implement customized, scalable and SOX compliant security solutions
* Advanced debugging and troubleshoot issues, including interacting with technology vendors
* Identify, design, customize and implement Oracle Risk Management Cloud Controls as part of Governance, Risk and Compliance solution
* Attend client design workshop sessions, design documentation by conducting workshops in onsite/offshore delivery model for projects


**Qualifications**
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* At least 3\-4 years of experience delivering full cycle of Oracle Cloud Security assessments, design, and implementations as well as understanding of leading practices relates to ERP security
* Demonstrate an understanding of business processes flows, cloud security risk, Oracle application security and risk management
* Experience in Oracle cloud security console, like building custom roles by tailoring Oracle seeded roles as per the business requirement and User administration activities like add/modify user accounts, add/remove roles, assign data security context and assign profiles etc.
* Experience in building Data roles, creating custom security profiles, area of responsibility (AOR) assignments, performing HDL loads, restricting payroll flows and document types
* Identifying key risks and controls, knowledge of Sarbanes Oxley readiness, controls optimization, as well as configuration of controls around security, business process and within the Oracle Cloud Risk Management Cloud (RMC) modules
* Experience in implementing role\-based security (ERP, EPM, OTBI), Oracle Cloud Quarterly patch analysis and regression testing, supporting Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including configuration in lower environments, migration, and QA, reviewing, audit end user accounts, permissions, and access rights, performing segregation of duties (SOD) and mitigating risks
* Experience in securing Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) reports/data models/subject areas/analysis
* Experience in coordinating with development teams, functional teams, business leads, information security \& risk management teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


 Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* Experience in Oracle GRC or Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) design, implementation or assessment experience including Advanced Access Controls (AAC), Advanced Financial Controls (AFC) and Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC)
* Experience in Oracle Cloud ERP/HCM modules
* Previous Consulting or Big 4 experience preferred
* Security Certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CISA is a plus
* Automation using Python, C\#, or VBA
* Troubleshooting and analytical skills using PL\-SQL queries


 Education:
   

  

* B.Tech/M.Tech/MS


 Location:
   

  

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


 \#Cyber\_Enterprise
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

71a1c678.title: Cloud Migration Engineer
71a1c678.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Cloud Migration Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high\-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next\-generation business outcomes.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 TIBCO Administration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Google Cloud Compute Services
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current systems and infrastructure to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes strategizing and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and deliver high performance. The position requires close collaboration with various teams to align migration efforts with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve innovative and efficient business outcomes.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless migration and integration of cloud solutions.
* Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure post\-migration to maintain performance and reliability.
* Document migration processes and best practices to support knowledge sharing within the team.
* Assist junior team members in understanding migration methodologies and troubleshooting techniques.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in TIBCO Administration.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Google Cloud Compute Services.
* Strong knowledge of cloud migration strategies and best practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and applications.
* Familiarity with private and public cloud environments and their respective technologies.
* Experience in performance tuning and capacity planning for cloud\-based systems.


**Additional Information**
* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in TIBCO Administration.
* This position is based at our DDC5E \- SEZ location.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

95cc06d7.title: Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead
95cc06d7.description:
Join us as a
 **Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead** 
 at Barclays, where you will drive strategic transformation across Technology Operations and IT Service Management—the backbone of the bank's operations responsible for maintaining service availability, reliability, resilience and operational stability. You will lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives spanning observability, AI\-enabled operations, event intelligence, SRE and automation, translating strategy into execution and ensuring measurable business outcomes through strong stakeholder alignment, delivery leadership and operational adoption.
   

  

 To be successful as
 **Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead,** 
 you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Enterprise Technology Transformation Delivery – leading complex, cross\-functional technology transformation programmes from strategy through execution and adoption.
* Strategic Delivery Leadership \& Navigating Ambiguity – Demonstrated ability to operate in complex and evolving environments, synthesising inputs from multiple stakeholders, delivery teams and business priorities to identify interdependencies, connect the dots, and translate ambiguity into clear, targeted and executable delivery plans.
* Technology Operations \& Engineering Practices – strong understanding of modern technology operations, including monitoring, observability, SRE, automation, event management, GenAI, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Influence \& Communication: Strong influencing skills with the ability to align multi\-faceted stakeholders across business units and technology teams, drive outcomes without direct authority, and communicate complex multi\-stream delivery, risks, dependencies and benefits to executive audiences.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills \& Experience Include**
* GenAI, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and AIOps transformation delivery.
* Leading organisational change, talent development, and workforce transformation to build the capabilities, behaviours and operating models required to sustain adoption of strategic change in line with long\-term business outcomes.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Reporting to the Finance Delivery Lead, the role ensures accurate and timely financial close, strong balance sheet governance, and audit ready financial reporting, while embedding robust quality assurance practices across all R2R outputs. The R2R Manager leads Associate Managers, individual Team Leads, and Analysts, and acts as a key partner to Finance Business Partners, Controllership, FP\&A, Audit, and Transformation teams. The role requires confident communication in English while operating in a multi stakeholder and international environment. Leadership \& Behavioural
   

  

* Confident people leader with strong coaching and influencing skills.
* Clear, structured communicator able to challenge constructively.
* Calm and resilient under close pressure.
* Strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a pragmatic, delivery focused approach. Success Measures (KPIs)
* On time and accurate financial close
* Reduction in errors, rework, and post close adjustments
* Quality and timeliness of balance sheet reconciliations
* Audit outcomes and reduction in repeat findings
* R2R service performance against SLAs
* Team capability, engagement, and retention What are we looking for? Education

* Proven experience managing R2R teams and end to end close delivery.
* Demonstrated ownership of quality assurance and financial review processes.

* English language proficiency at B2 level or higher (CEFR) is required. o Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in English, both written and spoken. o Comfortable leading close calls, governance meetings, audits, and producing senior level financial documentation in English. Audit, Risk \& Compliance
* Act as the senior R2R owner for internal and external audits.
* Coordinate audit requests, reviews, and management responses.
* Ensure timely and sustainable remediation of audit findings.
* Proactively identify risks and control gaps and implement mitigation actions. Continuous Improvement \& Transformation
* Drive standardisation and harmonisation of R2R processes across entities and regions.
* Identify and sponsor efficiency, automation, and simplification initiatives.
* Partner with Finance Transformation and IT on system changes, upgrades, and implementations.
* Ensure changes are implemented with appropriate controls, testing, and documentation.
* Track and report benefits realised from improvement initiatives. Key Skills \& Competencies Technical \& Functional
* Deep understanding of end to end R2R processes and accounting standards.
* Strong balance sheet governance and financial review capability.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong quality and risk mindset.
* Data driven approach to performance and issue management. Roles and Responsibilities:
* End to End R2R Service Ownership
* Own delivery of Record to Report services across all in scope entities, including: o Month end, quarter end, and year end closeo Journal entry governance and approvalso Accruals, prepayments, allocations, and reclassificationso Intercompany accounting and reconciliationso Fixed asset accounting
* Ensure close activities are delivered accurately, on time, and in line with close calendars, SLAs, and accounting standards.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex accounting, system, or close related issues.Quality Checks \& Financial Output Assurance
* Define, implement, and oversee quality assurance frameworks across R2R processes and deliverables.
* Ensure consistent and effective quality checks are performed on: o Journal entries and supporting documentationo Balance sheet reconciliations and substantiationo Variance analysis and management commentaryo Financial reports and close packs
* Review and challenge outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Monitor quality metrics (e.g., error rates, rework, post close adjustments) and drive continuous improvement.
* Identify recurring quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions to reduce defects and rework.Balance Sheet Governance \& Controls
* Own balance sheet governance for Shared Services R2R, ensuring: o Timely preparation and review of reconciliationso High quality substantiation and documentation standardso Clearance of aged and reconciling items with accountability
* Ensure strong execution of internal controls (SOX or equivalent), including journal approvals, reconciliation reviews, and close controls.
* Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence at all times.People Leadership \& Capability Management
* Lead and develop R2R Associate Managers, Junior Team Leads, and Analysts.
* Set clear expectations for delivery, quality, and control execution.
* Own capacity planning, workload balancing, and peak close resourcing.
* Drive capability development through coaching, training, and succession planning

**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Transfer Solutions team was created to establish Mastercard as the frontrunner in the fast\-evolving real\-time payments space, and to position Mastercard to be able to incubate the development of new payment flows. The team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technology that powers Mastercard’s next generation payment applications – Domestic, Cross Border and Bill Payments.
   

  

 Mastercard seeks to define a world beyond cash. To accelerate this mission, we are committed to building \& scaling products \& applications that transform payments of any type. Real time payment technology is central to this strategy.
   

  

**The Role**
 What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?
   

  

* Exhibits the behaviours of Lean Management and help multiple teams embrace agile process of Scrum, Kanban and Extreme Programming.
* Support multiple teams with implementation of agile rules \- rules of scrum, build in quality and limiting work in progress.
* Trained as a team facilitator and is continuously engaged in challenging the old norms of development to improve performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow, and velocity.
* Enable cadence and Synchronization across multiple teams so the individual team’s backlogs and solutions are understood, resolved, and integrated.
* Close collaboration with the product management to keep the backlog healthy, groomed and purged.
* Organizes and accelerates a group of related product engineering backlog items or activities across multiple teams, aligning dependent organizations. Identify and remove blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations
* Creates mechanisms to effectively report out and control execution. Recognizes complexity and creates predictable delivery paths for large and/or complex efforts. Measurably improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess processes. Utilizes cross organizational mechanisms to describe and drive continuous improvements.
* Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery through the full stack of the services / domains, or, an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise.
* Looked to as first point of contact for your team or area. and Maintains the backlogs as transparent source of truth for status providing the right information and associated data visually about the state backlog of


 the project to the right all the audience at the right all times. Maintains backlogs as always on information radiators on batch size and flow of work.
   

  

* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program or domain with depth to be credible and effective with teams they work with. Can competently and independently represent team’s services.

4df138b8.title: Software Solutions Engineer
4df138b8.description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1\) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end\-to\-end, and (2\) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will work across compute and cloud\-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU\-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer\-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain product\-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python\-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code\-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer\-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes\-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high\-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer\-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time\-to\-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance


**What We Need To See**
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5\+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C\+\+ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional\-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on\-prem or CSP environments
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes\-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control\-plane/data\-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

The role focuses on planning, assessing, designing, and executing datacenter exit and cloud migration programs to accelerate application modernization, infrastructure optimization, operational resilience, and cloud adoption for enterprise clients.

* Support cloud cost optimization, operational readiness, resiliency planning, and post\-migration stabilization activities.

* Experience with virtualization platforms including VMware and hybrid cloud environments.
* Knowledge of migration assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation frameworks.
* Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, automation frameworks, and cloud engineering practices.
* Experience working in client\-facing consulting, advisory, or cloud transformation engagements.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

**Technical Expertise:**
* Strong expertise in cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with cloud migration services including Azure Migrate, AWS Migration Hub, CloudEndure, Azure Site Recovery, AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), and related migration tools.
* Strong competency in infrastructure assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting, and Infrastructure Automation.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM Templates, Bicep, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of compute, storage, networking, identity, security, backup, and disaster recovery services across cloud platforms.
* Experience with virtualization and hybrid cloud technologies including VMware, Hyper\-V, and container\-based platforms.
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevOps and CI/CD tools including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, and automation frameworks.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Cosmos DB.
* Understanding of cloud governance, landing zones, operational readiness, observability, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience supporting application modernization, platform transformation, and cloud\-native adoption initiatives.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, and Grafana.

* Define architecture across:
	+ Contract models, clause libraries, and templates
	+ Workflow orchestration, approvals, and governance structures
	+ Obligation, compliance, and performance tracking models
* Integration architecture with upstream and downstream systems (ERP, CRM, sourcing, etc.)
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise architecture standards
* Translate complex business and legal requirements into robust, implementable solution designs


Implementation Leadership* Provide architectural oversight across all implementation phases: discovery, design, build, test, and deployment
* Guide functional and technical teams to ensure alignment with approved architecture
* Review configurations, integrations, and customizations for quality and consistency
* Proactively identify and mitigate design risks, technical debt, and scalability concerns

	+ Solution design and approach definition
	+ Client workshops and discovery sessions
	+ Product demonstrations and capability positioning
	+ Effort estimation and solution shaping
* Support RFP/RFI responses with clear, differentiated solution narratives
* Position Sirion CLM effectively against competing platforms

* Develop packaged solutions and offerings for common use cases such as:
	+ Procurement CLM
	+ Sales contracting
	+ Obligation and performance management
* Create and maintain accelerators, including:
	+ Pre\-built data models and templates
	+ Workflow blueprints
	+ Integration patterns
	+ Migration frameworks
* Drive consistency, repeatability, and quality across all engagements


Governance \& Quality Assurance* Establish architectural governance standards and review mechanisms
* Ensure adherence to best practices across functional and technical delivery
* Define guidelines for scalability, performance, security, and compliance
* Promote a design\-first, outcome\-driven delivery approach


Stakeholder Engagement* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership, including Legal, Procurement, IT, and business stakeholders
* Lead architecture discussions, trade\-off decisions, and roadmap planning
* Communicate complex architectural concepts in a clear and business\-friendly manner


Team Enablement \& Mentorship* Mentor functional and technical consultants on solution design and best practices
* Support capability building within the team on Sirion CLM and broader CLM architecture
* Contribute to internal training, knowledge sharing, and practice maturity initiatives


Qualifications:
**Experience*** 7\+ years of experience in CLM, legal operations, or enterprise application implementations
* 3\+ years of Sirion CLM experience in a senior solutioning or architecture role preferred
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise\-scale CLM implementations
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams

**Functional \& Architectural Expertise*** Deep understanding of:
	+ Contract lifecycle processes across buy\-side and sell\-side
	+ Clause and template management
	+ Workflow and approval design
	
	Obligation, compliance, and performance tracking  
	+
* Strong architectural knowledge across:
	+ System integrations and APIs
	+ Sirion Gen AI capabilities
	+ Data models and reporting structures
	+ Security and access control frameworks

**Skills*** Strong solutioning and problem\-solving capability
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and presentation skills
* Ability to operate at both strategic and hands\-on levels
* Experience working in a remote, globally distributed delivery model
* Strong documentation and structured thinking

**Preferred Qualifications*** Sirion CLM certifications or formal training
* Experience in consulting or system integrator environments
* Exposure to regulated industries such as BFSI, Life Sciences, Energy, or Telecom
* Experience building reusable assets or leading practice initiatives

**Consilio’s True North Values*** **Client Experience** \| Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* **Collaboration** \| Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* **Innovation** \| Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
* **Grit** \| Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

8abc3de5.description:
**About the job** 




 Onam Cloud is a sovereign cloud platform operated by Saints and Masters India Private Limited. We offer public cloud, dedicated private cloud, bare\-metal infrastructure, storage, Kubernetes, and hybrid and multi\-cloud connectivity for customers requiring greater control, performance, compliance, and digital sovereignty.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Engineer who can design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud and infrastructure solutions for Onam Cloud customers. You will own the technical aspects of the customer journey — from understanding requirements and designing solution architectures to conducting demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept deployments — and ensure approved solutions are clearly documented and handed over effectively to the implementation and operations teams.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Engage customers to understand their business, application, infrastructure, security, compliance, and operational requirements
* Assess digital sovereignty and data residency requirements and design solutions for government, BFSI, and other regulated sectors
* Design solutions across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, multi\-cloud, bare\-metal, and on\-premises environments
* Prepare solution architectures, bills of materials, technical proposals, presentations, implementation plans, and effort estimates
* Conduct product demonstrations, technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, and PoC deployments
* Recommend compute, storage, networking, virtualization, container, backup, and disaster recovery architectures
* Perform workload assessments and support migrations from VMware, on\-premises platforms, AWS, and Azure
* Recommend modern monitoring, observability, automation, and AIOps practices
* Work closely with Sales, Platform Engineering, Customer Success, implementation, and partner teams
* Support customer onboarding and ensure smooth handover to implementation and operations teams
* Maintain reusable solution templates, architecture diagrams, and technical documentation



**Required Skills** 



* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills
* Experience designing solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, hybrid\-cloud, and multi\-cloud environments
* Cloud\-native architecture experience with Kubernetes deployment and administration
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, load balancing)
* Virtualization expertise (KVM, Proxmox VE, VMware)
* Hands\-on knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, and infrastructure automation
* Understanding of bare\-metal infrastructure, server hardware, storage, RAID, and data\-centre environments
* Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, high availability, and capacity planning
* Familiarity with AIOps concepts (AI/ML\-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, observability)



**Preferred (nice to have)** 




 Ceph, KubeVirt, OpenStack/CloudStack, OPNsense, Arista/Cisco networking, Keycloak/LDAP/SSO, GitOps/CI\-CD, cloud security \& compliance controls
 



**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years in cloud infrastructure, solution architecture, systems engineering, pre\-sales, DevOps, or SRE
* Practical, hands\-on infrastructure experience essential
* Certifications preferred: AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, CKA, CKAD, RHCSA, LFCS, or equivalent

**OPENING FOR SENIOR ARCHITECTS –4\-10 YEARS**

**Company:** Cubatic Design  
**Website:** www.cubaticdesign.com

**About Us**

Cubatic Design is a multidisciplinary design studio specializing in **Architecture, Interior Design, Urban Design, and Landscape Design**. We are passionate about creating innovative, functional, and sustainable spaces that enhance the built environment. Our collaborative approach combines creativity, technical excellence, and attention to detail to deliver exceptional design solutions across diverse project scales.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a talented and experienced **Senior Architect** to lead architectural projects from concept development through execution. The ideal candidate will possess strong design capabilities, technical expertise, project management skills, and leadership qualities to successfully deliver high\-quality projects while mentoring and guiding design teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design Leadership**

* Lead the architectural design process from conceptual planning to detailed design and construction documentation.
* Develop innovative, functional, and aesthetically strong design solutions aligned with project goals and client expectations.
* Prepare and present design concepts, master plans, 3D visualizations, presentations, and design reports.
* Ensure design excellence while maintaining compliance with building regulations, zoning requirements, and industry standards.

**Project Planning \& Execution**

* Manage multiple projects across architecture, interiors, urban design, and landscape design disciplines.
* Coordinate with consultants, engineers, contractors, and project stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution.
* Monitor project schedules, design deliverables, and quality standards throughout all project phases.
* Conduct site visits, design reviews, and project evaluations as required.

**Technical Documentation**

* Oversee the preparation of construction drawings, working drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Ensure accuracy and quality control of all design and construction documents.
* Utilize AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion, Photoshop, and related software for design development and presentation.

**Team Management \& Mentorship**

* Lead, mentor, and supervise architects, designers, and drafting professionals.
* Review design outputs, technical drawings, and project submissions prepared by team members.
* Encourage collaboration, innovation, and professional growth within the design team.
* Support the Principal Architect in managing project teams and design coordination activities.

**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as a key point of contact for clients and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead client presentations, design discussions, and project meetings.
* Build strong professional relationships while ensuring client satisfaction and project success.

**Material \& Design Research**

* Research and recommend materials, finishes, products, and construction methodologies suitable for project requirements.
* Stay updated with emerging design trends, technologies, and sustainable design practices.
* Assist in preparing project specifications and material selections.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Architecture from a recognized and accredited institution.

**Experience**

* Minimum 4**–10 years of professional experience** in architecture and design.
* Experience working with architecture, interior design, urban design, or multidisciplinary design firms is preferred.
* Proven track record of successfully handling projects from concept to completion.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of architectural design principles, construction methodologies, building systems, and detailing.
* Thorough knowledge of building codes, zoning regulations, statutory approvals, and site planning requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in:
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Lumion
* Adobe Photoshop
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with Revit/BIM workflows will be considered an added advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong design vision and creative problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership and team management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* High level of attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
* Strong analytical thinking and decision\-making skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and adaptable to evolving project requirements.

**Why Join Cubatic Design?**

* Opportunity to work on diverse Architecture, Interior, Urban Design, and Landscape projects.
* Collaborative and creative work environment.
* Exposure to innovative design challenges and multidisciplinary projects.
* Professional growth and leadership opportunities.
* Platform to contribute to meaningful and impactful design solutions.

**Join Cubatic Design and help shape inspiring spaces that define the future of design.**

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. * Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues

* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations

----------------


We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to support end\-to\-end architecture across PUMA’s global DTC technology landscape. In this role, you will ensure scalable, stable, and future\-proof architecture decisions across digital and physical touchpoints. You will advise and enable Product and Project Teams by aligning business strategy, product roadmaps, and technology architecture, while ensuring high solution quality, strong non\-functional standards, and sustainable platform evolution. **Description**
 Salesforce Professional Services India partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest\-priority growth markets.
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with deep specialization in Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing sectors, alongside mastery of the Salesforce ecosystem and AI\-first engineering practices.
   

  

 In this role, you won't just be designing systems; you will be a Trusted Advisor, guiding our premier enterprise clients through complex, AI\-driven digital transformations. You will bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and robust technical execution, maintaining a "Full Stack Mindset" that covers everything from high\-level discovery to hands\-on deployment.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Leadership: Lead the end\-to\-end design and architecture of complex, multi\-cloud Salesforce solutions specifically tailored for FINS, RCG, Automotive, or Manufacturing challenges.
* Enterprise AI Architecture: Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits.
* Architectural Simulation \& Design: Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases.
* Cross\-Cloud Innovation: While rooted in Salesforce, you will explore and integrate solutions across Industry Clouds (Financial Services Cloud, Consumer Goods Cloud, Automotive Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, or Revenue Cloud) and third\-party ecosystems to ensure the business receives the most efficient solution.
* Discovery to Go\-Live: Own the technical and functional scope throughout the project lifecycle. This includes leading discovery workshops, defining data governance and guardrails, and ensuring a smooth transition to Go\-Live.
* Team Orchestration: Provide technical governance and mentorship to large, diverse teams of developers and testers, ensuring code quality, security models, and architectural integrity.
* Hands\-on Excellence: While your focus is strategic, you are willing and able to "get into the weeds" to solve high\-complexity technical hurdles or build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) when required.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Domain \& Technical Expertise**
* Multi\-Domain Specialist: Extensive experience navigating at least one key industry landscape—Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing.
* Salesforce \& Industry Cloud Mastery: Proven track record in Salesforce architecture, with a focus on Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Consumer Goods Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or Revenue Cloud (CPQ \& Billing), alongside Sales/Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* AI\-First Delivery Methodology: Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects.
* Complex Engagements: Experience leading at least 3\+ large\-scale, complex Salesforce implementations for global enterprise brands across target industries.
* Full\-Stack Mindset: Comfort working across the entire stack—from UI/UX considerations and Apex/LWC development to complex integrations (MuleSoft/REST/SOAP) and data architecture.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
**Domain \& Industry Expertise**
* 12\+ years in IT with at least 3\+ years specifically in Financial Services, Retail/Consumer Goods, Manufacturing, OR Automotive domains.
* Proven track record of delivering at least 2–3 large\-scale, complex engagements for global enterprise brands.
* Deep understanding of industry\-specific flows in at least one of the following areas:
+ Financial Services (FINS): Wealth Management \& Client Onboarding, Commercial/Retail Banking, Insurance Policy \& Claims Lifecycle, Household/Relationship Mapping, and Regulatory Compliance (KYC/AML/FINRA).
+ RCG: Route\-to\-market, Retail Execution, Trade Promotion Management (TPM), Scheme Management, and B2B/B2C Commerce.
+ Manufacturing \& Auto: Sales Agreements, Account Forecasting, Vehicle/Asset Lifecycle Management, Partner/Dealer Portals, and Lead Management.
+ Revenue Management: CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), Subscription Management, Billing, Contract Lifecycle, and Order Management.


**Technical Prowess**
